gpu_cost_estimate.basis: *** REV-1 j-WEIGHTED, replacing the flat 4 x 0.8144 the affordability lens refuted. Reproduce: `python proposal/backlog/B05-semantic-handoff-phase-diagram/code/b05_cost_model.py` (0 GPU, reads only on-disk JSON). MODEL: k_ceiling(j,L) = [write_s fitted at j, floored at its j=9 value + (select_s+read_s+decode_s) PINNED at their j=9 values] / (per-query total at j=9). Deliberately CONSERVATIVE: write grows on its measured slope (incl. a flagged linear extrapolation to the unmeasured j=18), while every term MEASURED TO FALL with j is pinned rather than credited -- an upper bound per rung by construction. TIMING ANCHOR (j=9, the only on-disk native run on exactly these 4 cells with the real harness): ruler_results/qcmem_8b_zeroshot_j9_chatFALSE/{cell}_shard*of8.json 'elapsed_seconds', max over 8 shards x 8 GPUs: niah_multikey_1_16k 37.0s -> 0.0822 GPU-h; niah_multikey_1_32k 70.2s -> 0.1561; variable_tracking_16k 67.6s -> 0.1502; variable_tracking_32k 191.6s -> 0.4259; per-arm 0.8143. J-WEIGHTED SUM: N6 0.8143 + N9 0.8183 + N12 0.8363 + N18 0.8732 = 3.3421 GPU-h, i.e. +0.085 GPU-h (+2.6%) ABOVE the refuted flat 3.2572 -- the j-weighting RAISES the estimate, exactly as the lens's mechanism predicts. CROSS-CHECK (independent, sm_90): A02_READ_TAX_RULER_VERDICT.md:3 = 78 min wall x 8 H20 = 10.4 GPU-h for 50 cells -> 0.208 GPU-h/cell x 16 = 3.33 GPU-h, agreeing to 0.4%. BUDGET: 3.3421 x 2.824 = 9.5 GPU-h, where 2.824 is the measured worst-case decode-cap inflation (bench decodes n_decode=20 but scripts/eval_ruler_qcmem.py:602-603 allows 48, overridden to 60 for variable_tracking; the collapsed N18 arm is the case most likely to run to the cap). The headroom is now derived from a harness parameter, not a round 50%.

gpu_cost_estimate.lens_subclause_refuted_with_measurement: The affordability lens wrote 'approx_tokens differ per rung'. THEY DO NOT. The same bench files record rows[].qcmem.seq_len == 6657 at EVERY j in {0,6,9,12} and EVERY length in {8k,16k,32k,64k,128k}: the read pack is a fixed topk=12 x chunk=512 budget, so j changes WHICH LAYERS run, not HOW MANY TOKENS. A cost model built on approx_tokens would be wrong. Asserted at code/b05_cost_model.py:95 (bench_rows), emitted as fit.<L>.seq_len_invariant_across_j. DECISIVE COROLLARY, and the reason the flat estimate did not blow up: write_s is a small share of the per-query total and the DOMINANT term decode_s FALLS with j (resuming at layer j runs only layers[j:L] for each of the 20-60 decode steps). Measured per-query totals write+select+read+decode: 16k j0 21.39 -> j12 16.13 s; 32k j0 21.27 -> j12 17.20 s -- end-to-end cost DECREASES monotonically in j on every measured rung. A j-weighted sum over MEASURED totals would therefore come out BELOW the refuted flat figure, which is why this model pins the falling terms instead: reporting a lower number would look like evading the lens.

kill_gate.statement: B05 dies as a standalone paper if ANY of three clauses trips on the 4 retrieval-CLOSED RULER cells (niah_multikey_1 x {16k,32k}, variable_tracking x {16k,32k}) at Qwen3-8B. K1 COUNT: fewer than 3 of the phases {I joint-readability, II handoff-band, III joint-failure} are non-empty over the rungs j in {6,9,12,18}. K2 CROSS-TASK: the Phase I/II boundary index differs by >= 2 between niah_multikey_1 and variable_tracking, measured in the ordered rung indices [BELOW,6,9,12,18] = 0..4, over that task's MONOTONE cells only; a task with NO located boundary FAILS K2 rather than passing by default. K3 SCATTER (new in REV-1): fewer than 3 of the 4 primary cells are monotone in rung index. j=0 is index 0 (named BELOW), is Phase I by construction (teacher==student at resume_j=0 per A02 GATE 0; A1 vs A0 = 0 flips / 400 paired items), is EXCLUDED from every non-emptiness test, and exists only to anchor the monotonicity check.
kill_gate.cell_to_rung_rule: *** THE decidability LENS FIX. A rung j is assigned phase P iff >= 3 of its 4 cells carry label P; otherwise the rung is MIXED and counts toward neither phase. A 2-2 tie is MIXED, never resolved toward either phase. A MISSING cell counts as disagreement, not abstention: the denominator is always 4, so dropping a cell cannot silently lower the bar from 3-of-4 to 2-of-3. Implemented at code/b05_phase_assign.py:188 (rung_label); all three properties are asserted in the selftest. Without this rule a rung had NO defined phase label when its 4 cells disagreed, which is why the lens returned decidable=false.
kill_gate.monotonicity_guard: *** THE falsifiability LENS FIX, and it is BOTH a guard and a clause. A cell is MONOTONE iff phase SEVERITY {I:1, II:2, III:3} is non-decreasing along rung indices 0->4 over the ordered list [BELOW,6,9,12,18]. A label with no severity (MIXED_CELL / UNDEFINED) makes the cell NON-MONOTONE rather than being skipped -- skipping would let a hole in the ladder read as a clean ordering, which is exactly the 'non-monotone scatter read as separation' failure the lens named. (a) As a GUARD: a non-monotone cell votes on NO boundary, so K2 cannot be satisfied or violated by a scatter. (b) As CLAUSE K3: a guard that only invalidated K2 would leave a total scatter able to satisfy K1, since each rung could still win a >=3-of-4 majority while the ordering ACROSS rungs was noise. Implemented at code/b05_phase_assign.py:211 (cell_is_monotone).
kill_gate.threshold: FLOOR = 6.0 pp absolute paired delta per cell AND exact two-sided McNemar p < 0.05. Both conditions, not either. DERIVED, NOT INVENTED: at n=100 with one-directional discordance (which is what 20/20 comparator cells show, n10=0 in every one) exact two-sided p = 2^(1-k) for k discordant pairs, so 2^(1-k) < 0.05 <=> k >= 6. The 6.0 pp figure IS the design's minimum detectable effect. Phase-separation thresholds: >= 3 of 3 phases non-empty (K1); cross-task boundary agreement within 1 rung index (K2); >= 3 of 4 cells monotone (K3).
kill_gate.floor_recalibration_rev1: *** A DEFECT NO LENS RAISED. The old FLOOR (4.0 pp + bootstrap-percentile CI excluding 0) was calibrated on A02 calling -4.0 pp [-8,-1] SIGNIFICANT on ruler|niah_multikey_1|32k arm A3. That cell's discordance table is n01=4, n10=0, whose EXACT two-sided McNemar p is 0.125 -- NOT significant. The old floor therefore inherited a false positive. Two independent reasons the exact test replaces the bootstrap: (1) the percentile bootstrap over-rejects on sparse one-directional discordance, and that is the regime here (n10=0 in 20/20 cells); (2) per memory/numpy-version-split-breaks-cross-node-bootstrap the five nodes carry three numpy versions (LOCAL 2.3.5 / .82 2.4.6 / rest 2.5.1) with same-seed multinomial divergence, so a bootstrap-derived phase label could FLIP with the node that ran the analyzer, whereas math.comb is exact integer arithmetic and node-invariant. The bootstrap CI is still computed and emitted for continuity with A02's published table but NEVER decides a label; every cell carries stat_decides_label so the substitution is auditable. HONEST DIRECTIONALITY: raising the floor makes the K1 Phase-I-empty route HARDER to trigger, while K3 adds a route the old gate did not have. Both pre-data.

Per-rung LoRA comparators, all on disk (zwfy6): A2=a02_rtax_ruler_A2_j6, A3=a02_rtax_ruler_A3_j9, A4=a02_ruler_c2_j12_readlora, A5=a02_rtax_ruler_A5_j18. Comparison is arm-vs-NAMED-arm on paired items joined by input_ids_sha256, not 'better than baseline'. RE-ADJUDICATED UNDER THE REV-1 FLOOR (0 GPU, this session, from a02_read_tax_per_item_vectors.json): A2 j=6 SAME-as-anchor in 4/4 cells; A3 j=9 SAME in 4/4 (the -4.0 pp cell flips SIG->ns); A4 j=12 BELOW in 3/4; A5 j=18 BELOW in 4/4. kill_gate.what_result_stops_the_work: THREE independent kill routes, each ASSERTED (not merely described) in code/b05_phase_assign.py:430 selftest_gate, which PASSES. (K1) If N6 returns ~78/85/61/58 and the deeper rungs at or below that, every rung in {6,9,12,18} has native BELOW A0 by >= 6.0 pp with exact p < 0.05, Phase I is EMPTY on the ladder, only II and III populated, 2 < 3, KILL: the read tax is then a two-regime cliff, which Paper A already reports, and B05 has no third phase to name. (K2) If N6 = 99/99/62/59 with N9 = 99/96/18/16, niah_multikey_1 leaves Phase I at index 3 while variable_tracking leaves at index 1 -- gap 2 -- KILL even though three phases exist on the pooled view. (K3) If native DIPS AND RECOVERS, e.g. N6 ~ 40/42/38/41 but N9 ~ 99/99/99/100, severity decreases somewhere in 4/4 cells, 0 < 3, KILL -- correctly, because a non-monotone readout curve is not a phase boundary no matter how many phase labels appear in it. All three are plausible on the on-disk numbers; see honest_power_disclosure.
kill_gate.denominator_guard:
PRIMARY QUANTITIES ARE ABSOLUTE PAIRED pp. NO KILL CLAUSE DEPENDS ON ANY RATIO, so an ill-defined recovery fraction can never block or trigger the gate. Anchor A0 = 100.0 on 3 of the 4 retrieval-closed cells (Wilson lo 96.3) and 99.0 on the fourth, so any recovery fraction R_j = (LoRA_j - native_j)/(A0 - native_j) has a denominator that can be 0 or negative. R_j is computed ONLY IF (A0 - native_j) >= 10.0 pp AND that denominator is itself significant under the exact test (p < 0.05); otherwise the analyzer MUST emit {"recovery_fraction": null, "reason": "denominator pp < 10.0pp or exact p=

>= 0.05 -> Delta ill-defined"} and the phase assignment falls back to the absolute-pp rule. This bites at j=6 where native may sit at the ceiling and the denominator -> 0. Enforced at code/b05_phase_assign.py:250 (recovery_fraction); the selftest asserts null at a 0 pp denominator AND at a 2 pp denominator, and a real value at a 60 pp denominator. CEILING CENSORING is declared pre-data: an arm at 100.0 against an anchor at 100.0 has an unmeasurable positive Delta, flagged at_ceiling_positive_censored; such cells may support 'indistinguishable' but may NEVER support 'better than'. Per memory/a-range-is-not-a-measurement-until-it-clears-its-floor.
kill_gate.honest_power_disclosure: Phase III is ALREADY non-empty and cannot fail: A02 A5 (j=18, LoRA) is BELOW the anchor in 4/4 cells (-68/-57/-96/-95 pp, exact p < 1e-5 each). If LoRA is dead at j=18 native cannot be alive there; that clause carries no discriminating power and is not pretended to. Phase II is very likely non-empty given the motivation merge (native j=9 = 34.25 vs LoRA j=9 = 98.25, and A3 re-adjudicates SAME-as-anchor in 4/4 under the new floor so the LoRA side of the Phase II condition holds at j=9). ALL of K1's power sits in Phase I, i.e. whether ANY rung j >= 6 still has an intact native readout, and the evidence genuinely does not settle it: QCMEM_J_DETERMINATION.md brackets the 8B zero-shot cliff at j9=100/j10=81/j12=9 on niah_single 16k (suggesting native survives j=6), but the merge of ruler_results/qcmem_8b_zeroshot_j9_chatFALSE on the HARDER retrieval-closed cells gives only 44/59/18/16 -- so the cliff on THESE cells is already shallower than j=9, and whether it is shallower than j=6 is UNMEASURED. K3 is independently open, and this is new information the old gate could not use: A02's own LoRA ladder is non-monotone in raw accuracy at niah_multikey_1 32k (j6=99.0, j9=95.0, j12=96.0, i.e. it RECOVERS by 1 pp). Under the 6.0 pp floor that wobble is inside the floor so that cell still labels monotone -- but it shows per-cell non-monotonicity of the size K3 cares about is a real behaviour of this measurement, not a hypothetical, and the native column has no reason to be smoother than the LoRA column.
kill_gate.what_it_does_NOT_mean: Firing is NOT 'the direction was wrong'. B05's pre-existing exit clause executes: fold into a Paper A/B mechanism subsection. 'readout capacity and split depth are not separable into named phases at this resolution' is itself a reportable negative for Paper A. Per memory/prior-work-differentiate-dont-abandon, no literature finding can fire this gate -- only these 16 cells can.

The load-bearing one: at n=100 with a 6.0 pp MDE the gate cannot resolve a genuine 3-5 pp handoff band, so a gently-degrading native curve would read as [I,I,III,III] and fire K1 on an ABSENCE OF RESOLUTION rather than an absence of structure.
